projects.name: UDOT STIP_Projects (ePM)
projects.notes: UDOT ePM project lines, all statuses including closed projects. Planned/in development = PIN_STAT_NM in (Proposed, Concept Scoping, Scoping, Funding, STIP, Active, Region Review, Central Review, Advertised) or PIN_STATUS_PHASE_DESC in (Concept Development, Planning/Funding, Funding, STIP, Design, Advertising); built = Under Construction / Awarded / Substantially Compl / Physically Complete / Closed. Other useful fields: PIN_STATUS_PHASE_DESC, PRIMARY_CONCEPT (136 detailed concepts e.g. 'Widen Existing Facility', 'New Interchange on Existing Freeway'), PLANNED_CONSTRUCTION_YEAR, FORECAST_ST_YR, PROJECTED_START_DATE, PROJ_LOC, ENV_DOC_TYPE_CD, Municipality_Name. Dates epoch ms. EPM/STIP_2024/MapServer/0 returned the same 3,219 records and schema.

parcels_statewide_note: null for owners: UGRC's Utah Statewide Parcels (https://services1.arcgis.com/99lidPhWCzftIe9K/arcgis/rest/services/UtahStatewideParcels/FeatureServer/0, 1.6M records, verified) has parcel id, address, county and OWN_TYPE (ownership class) but NO owner name.

parcels_counties.name: Weber County - Parcel Master (gis/parcels_geogizmo2)
parcels_counties.restrictions: No terms on the layer or service (description and copyrightText empty). Weber County's site-wide Online Terms of Use (https://www.webercountyutah.gov/disclaimer.php, 'COPYRIGHT LIMITATIONS') allow copying and distribution only 'for personal or informational use': 'Anyone may view, copy or distribute information found within these web pages ... for personal or informational use without owing an obligation to the County if the documents are not modified in any respect, and unless otherwise stated on the particular materials'. Commercial use, solicitation and mailing lists are not addressed; no Utah statute is cited.
parcels_counties.notes: Weber County's own ArcGIS server (Ogden). Tax year 2026 (TaxYear, ASSESSED_YR = 2026). NAME_ONE filled on 114,590 of 115,765 parcels; PRIVATE_FLAG is 0 on every record. One owner name field only. ZIPCODE is 9 digits without a hyphen ('844019815'); CITY_STATE is one text field ('TAYLOR UT'). Also TOT_TAXABLE, PROP_DESC, ACCOUNT_TYPE, SUBDIVISIO. The same schema is served at gis/OpenGov_Layers/MapServer/9 and assessor/Assessed_Values_Map_2026/MapServer/0. The terms page also says the County 'may determine to charge a fee for accessing or using information'. maxRecordCount 2000.

parcels_counties.name: Cache County - Cache Parcels (BaseMap/Parcels_Current)
parcels_counties.restrictions: Stated in the service's copyrightText: 'Use Limitations: Cache County GIS parcel data is derived from the County's internal taxroll system and is subject to the restrictions outlined in Cache County CORE Terms and Conditions. Resale, redistribution, or republication of County data is prohibited without authorization. Owner names and other identifying information may constitute Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and are subject to applicable privacy laws. Access to this service does not grant additional rights to use, disclose, or distribute PII.' Questions on permitted use are directed to the Cache County Clerk. The CORE Terms and Conditions themselves could not be read (core.cachecounty.gov returned no readable text).
parcels_counties.notes: Cache County's own ArcGIS server (Logan). Live data: newest last_edited_date is 2026-11-23. owner_name filled on 59,812 of 60,645 parcels. A field named 'restricted' is non-null on 357 parcels. owner_address_complete did not match owner_address1 + owner_city_state_zip on one sample record, so use the separate fields. There is no single total value field: land_market_value and building_market_value are separate and null on some parcels. Also legal, year_built, district_code_definition, core_url. maxRecordCount 8000.

summary: UDOT ePM STIP line layer verified (3,219 projects with status, concept, value, advertise date). Parcels: statewide layer has no owner names; Salt Lake County verified with owner + mailing address; Utah County has owner name on only ~30% of parcels; Davis, Weber, Washington county owner layers not found. Third pass 2026-11-23: Weber, Cache, Box Elder, Iron, Summit and Morgan county owner layers verified but all held (stated limits for Weber and Cache, terms not found for the rest); Davis not found, Washington's server timed out.
